housing.summary: Newcastle (NSW) is more affordable than Sydney. A 1-bedroom apartment in the city centre typically rents for approximately AUD 350–430 per week. NSW's Residential Tenancies Act caps the bond at 4 weeks rent. Primary rental portals are realestate.com.au and domain.com.au.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Australia, new arrivals typically need a valid passport, proof of Australian address, and a Tax File Number (TFN). CommBank allows account opening up to 14 days before arrival. ANZ and NAB also serve new residents.
required_docs: Valid passport (original required for in-branch ID verification within 20 days)

schools.summary: Newcastle has a range of public and private schools; IB programmes are available at select schools. The national school directory myschool.edu.au lists all NSW schools in the Newcastle region. State schools are under the NSW Department of Education.

legal_admin.summary: Visa holders in Australia must notify the Department of Home Affairs of any address changes. New residents should register with myGov (my.gov.au) to link ATO, Medicare, and Centrelink services.
legal_admin.registration_step: Register with myGov; notify Home Affairs of address changes

tax_finance.summary: All workers and income earners in Australia require a Tax File Number (TFN) from the Australian Taxation Office (ATO). Apply online for free at ato.gov.au.

transport.summary: Newcastle public transport is operated by Transport for NSW using the Opal card. The network includes buses and the Newcastle Light Rail. Fares are distance-based using the Opal system with daily and weekly caps. Overseas licence holders in NSW must exchange to an NSW licence via Service NSW upon becoming a NSW resident. Medicare registration via Services Australia.
transport.network_name: Transport for NSW (Opal) / Newcastle Light Rail
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Overseas licence holders must exchange to an NSW driver's licence via Service NSW upon becoming a NSW resident. Exchange requires identity documents, overseas licence, and eye test.
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible visa holders enrol in Medicare at Services Australia offices or online via servicesaustralia.gov.au/medicare.
